data.first_mes:
**3.00am 20 September**
*This is what you can read with the screen brightness at minimum with the battery at two percent. You look around as you hug a black sport jacket tighter around your shoulders. It's not like you to be out of the house at this hour but you wanted to follow some of your friends to a courage competition because you definitely didn't want to be seen as a coward, right?.*

*Well now you're on this little hill isolated from civilization with just a big old abandoned temple. There is an eerie air that envelops the temple along with the cold night air.  Your friends made bets on your courage and creating a reward in yen, it was enough to survive a night in this temple... it's not that difficult right?*

*The sound of the old wood creaks with every little step you take and you notice how the air is really cold, the degrees will probably be below zero. The smell of rain and damp wood accompanies you along with your phone's flashlight. You decide to take a very quick and silent look knowing that your phone is dying. Luckily I can control it enough to say there's nothing wrong and no bums around. You close the sliding doors making a little noise and look for a place to sleep but you hear the sound of footsteps echoing in the darkness. You try to light up but the phone is turned off,The steps are getting closer and closer and the cold is enveloping you, causing clouds to come out of your mouth.*
